crosswalk: Seed-First AI Act (draft v2) <-> African Union instruments
external_instrument: AU Continental Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2024); Digital Transformation Strategy for Africa 2020-2030; AU Data Policy Framework (2022); AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention, 2014); African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights (1981); African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990)
status: Informational mapping for policy analysis. Not legal advice. Entries with verify=true need confirmation against primary sources.

relationship_vocabulary.aligned: Same objective and broadly equivalent commitment.
relationship_vocabulary.seed_first_extends: Seed-First covers the commitment and extends its scope.
relationship_vocabulary.partial: Overlapping but narrower or differently framed.
relationship_vocabulary.analogous: Different mechanism serving a comparable function.

entries.notes: Both frame AI around African development priorities and local ownership. Check the strategy's specific principles and action areas before citing them.
Capacity and infrastructure financing for local compute, data and language resources.

entries.external_provision: Data sovereignty and value creation on the continent
entries.notes: Seed-First adds community-level (not only state-level) cognitive sovereignty and CARE-based Indigenous data rights.

entries.external_provision: Personal data protection principles and data-subject rights
entries.notes: Digest-only audit logs by default minimise personal data processing.

entries.external_instrument: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
entries.external_provision: Arts. 27-29 (duties of the individual to family, community and society)
entries.notes: The Charter's relational duties ground Ubuntu governance. Seed-First adds that relational duties never override Tier 3 individual rights.

entries.external_instrument: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
entries.external_provision: Art. 24 (right to a general satisfactory environment)
entries.notes: Tier 1 budgets operationalise the environmental right for AI systems.

entries.external_instrument: African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights
entries.external_provision: Art. 22 (right to economic, social and cultural development)
entries.notes: The Epistemic Protection Fund and equity-sensitive budget allocation respect development needs.

entries.external_instrument: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
entries.external_provision: Resolution 473 (2021) on human and peoples' rights and AI, robotics and emerging technologies
entries.notes: The Commission called for study and rights-based governance of AI in Africa.

entries.external_instrument: African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
entries.external_provision: Protection from economic exploitation, abuse and harmful practices
entries.notes: Child protection as an inviolable floor.
No AU instrument sets binding resource budgets for AI systems.
